name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: body
label: Body
help: The words, up to 10,000 characters.

name: person_name
label: Person Name
help: Who gave it.

name: person_email
label: Person Email
help: Their email. Never public. An address already on the site links to that person

name: person_title
label: Person Title
help: Their job title

name: person_company
label: Person Company
help: Their company

name: person_company_url
label: Person Company URL
help: The company's website

name: person_social_url
label: Person Social URL
help: A link to their profile

name: rating
label: Rating
help: 1 to 5 stars. Leave empty for no rating.

name: title
label: Title
help: Optional, up to 200 characters

name: highlight
label: Highlight
help: The best sentence. Must be an exact part of body

name: received_at
label: Received At
help: When they gave it. Defaults to now. A day alone (2026-10-10) is that day by the site's clock

name: source_name
label: Source Name
help: Where it came from, e.g. Email, Chat or a review site

name: source_url
label: Source URL
help: A public link to it

name: language
label: Language
help: Language code. Defaults to the site's language

name: status
label: Status
help: pending (the default) or approved

name: tags
label: Tags
help: Tag names or IDs. A name that does not exist yet is created.

name: collection_ids
label: Collections
help: Manual collections to add it to.

name: properties
label: Properties
help: Custom property values by key as a JSON object, like {"plan":"pro"}, as set up in the site's testimonial settings.

name: pinned
label: Pinned
help: Shown first wherever it is displayed

name: external_id
label: External ID
help: Your own ID for it, such as the review or ticket ID. Sending the same one again returns the testimonial already stored instead of a copy.

name: allow_duplicate
label: Allow Duplicate
help: true saves it even though this person already said these words
